title: Jill's Dairy — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk fingerpicked acoustic guitar Italian German language learning warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe dairy farm portrait quiet certainty
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Four in the morning. The dairy doesn't wait.
She knew every name. The rhythm was hers.
You knew where you stood with Jill — solid ground.
She didn't say it twice. She didn't need to.

[Verse 2 - Italian, with English translations]
Quattro di mattina. La latteria non aspetta. (Four in the morning. The dairy doesn't wait.)
Conosceva ogni nome. Il ritmo era suo. (She knew every name. The rhythm was hers.)
Sapevi dove ti trovavi con Jill — terra solida. (You knew where you stood with Jill — solid ground.)
Non lo diceva due volte. Non ne aveva bisogno. (She didn't say it twice. She didn't need to.)
Alcune persone tengono le famiglie unite in silenzio. (Some people hold families together quietly.)
Jill lo faceva in silenzio. (Jill did it quietly.)
Il che è più difficile. (Which is harder.)

[Chorus - German, with English translations]
Jills Molkerei (Jill's dairy)
In den Stunden bevor die Welt aufwacht (In the hours before the world wakes)
Jills Molkerei (Jill's dairy)
Wo die echte Arbeit in der Dunkelheit erledigt wird (Where the real work gets done in the dark)
Jills Molkerei (Jill's dairy)
Wo Gewissheit eine Morgengewohnheit ist (Where certainty is a morning habit)
Und die Kühe nach Hause kommen (And the cows come home)
Weil Jill da ist (Because Jill is there)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The dairy didn't fail. The family didn't fail. These things are connected.
Italian: La latteria non ha fallito. La famiglia non ha fallito. Queste cose sono collegate. (The dairy didn't fail. The family didn't fail. These things are connected.)
German: Die Molkerei hat nicht versagt. Die Familie hat nicht versagt. Diese Dinge sind verbunden. (The dairy didn't fail. The family didn't fail. These things are connected.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made
Italian: La latteria di Jill — ancora nella famiglia che ha creato (Jill's dairy — still in the family it made)
German: Jills Molkerei — noch in der Familie, die sie gemacht hat (Jill's dairy — still in the family it made)
